# Media fixture

`flower.webm` is the CC0 video sample distributed with MDN interactive examples:
https://interactive-examples.mdn.mozilla.net/media/cc0-videos/flower.webm

It is used only to verify Chromium video decoding and player controls in the
isolated Electron test. It is not bundled with the application. Audio test
data is generated silence, and profile/image test data uses the local logo.
